title: Customer Service Administrator
description: Our client is seeking a proactive and customer-focused temporary Customer Service Administrator to join their friendly and growing team. This is a varied role combining customer service, order management and administration, making it ideal for someone who enjoys resolving customer queries and working closely with internal teams to ensure an exceptional customer experience. The successful candidate will be responsible for handling customer enquiries, managing delivery issues and returns, and supporting the wider business with day-to-day administrative tasks. Company Benefits: - Hybrid working available (2-3 days in the office and 2-3 days from home). - On-site parking. - Varied role with exposure to multiple areas of the business. Key Responsibilities: - Responding to customer enquiries and resolving issues via the company's customer support platform. - Liaising with warehouse and logistics teams to investigate and resolve delivery-related queries. - Managing courier communications and tracking deliveries to ensure successful order fulfilment. - Identifying lost or delayed parcels and coordinating replacement orders where necessary. - Processing returns and refund requests in line with company procedures. - Issuing return authorisations and maintaining accurate records of pending refunds. - Coordinating with internal teams to ensure returned goods are received and processed correctly. - Arranging customer refunds and ensuring all transactions are completed accurately. - Maintaining accurate customer records and updating internal systems. - Supporting the wider team with administrative and operational tasks as required. Experience and Skills Requirements - Previous experience within a customer service, sales support, order processing or administration role. - Experience working with CRM, ERP or warehouse management systems. - E-commerce customer service experience would be highly advantageous. - Experience dealing directly with consumers and providing a high level of customer care. - Previous experience liaising with courier and logistics providers. - Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. - Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. - Good attention to detail and problem-solving abilities. - Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and business systems. - Flexible, team-oriented approach and willingness to support different areas of the business. If you have not been contacted within 5 working days, then unfortunately on this occasion your CV has not been shortlisted.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Customer Contact Advisor Full-time Monday to Friday 13.00 per hour About the role Our client is seeking a proactive Customer Contact Adviser to manage and support a portfolio of customer accounts and driver routes for the division. You will be responsible for delivering excellent customer service, retaining and developing accounts, and working closely with our drivers and operations team to ensure smooth, accurate deliveries. Key Responsibilities - Build and maintain strong relationships with allocated customer accounts - Make outbound and inbound calls to customers, processing orders, exchanges and sanitisation - Accurately input and update all orders on system and ensure they are allocated to the correct delivery routes - Carry out daily route calls to customers, amending deliveries as required - Take ownership of customer queries, resolving them within agreed timescales - Work closely with drivers to maintain accurate route and customer data - Complete all administration tasks accurately and on time in line with procedures - Collaborate with colleagues across the business to maintain excellent working relationships - Ensure adherence to all Health & Safety requirements - Undertake any additional reasonable tasks as required by the company About You - Able to work on own initiative as well as part of a team - Strong sense of ownership for customer queries and accounts - Excellent telephone manner and communication skills - Strong planning and organising skills - High attention to detail and accuracy - Resilient, with excellent customer service skills and able to cope well under pressure Knowledge & Experience - Previous customer service experience (contact centre or similar environment advantageous) - Good understanding of routes and geographical areas (or ability to learn quickly) What you'll get - Opportunity to build long-term relationships with a core customer base - A collaborative, supportive team environment - Training on systems, products and routes - Clear expectations and performance measures, with support from your management team If you're customer-focused, organised and confident on the phone, and you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same, we'd like to hear from you.
